issues.detail: The Hebrew phrase 'מֵחֲרֹשֶׁת הַגּוֹיִם' (from Harosheth-ha-goiim) is a proper place name, 'Harosheth of the nations' (or 'Harosheth-ha-goiim'), not '民族的雕刻處' ('the carving place of the nations'). The word 'חֲרֹשֶׁת' here is a place name, not the common noun for 'craftsmanship/carving' (חָרָשָׁה). This mistranslation changes the meaning from a geographical location to a descriptive phrase.
